Config files exactly as each server software wrote them on its first start
(2026-10-08, default settings, nothing edited). The Loader tab's schema is
tested against these: every setting must find its key here, and an edit must
change only that key's line. Regenerate by starting the named build once.

- paper-26.3: Paper 26.3 build 159
- neoforge-26.3.0.57: NeoForge 26.3.0.57-beta (renamed neoforge-synced.toml)
- neoforge-21.1.256: NeoForge 21.1.256 (neoforge-server.toml)
- forge-66.0.9: Forge 26.3-66.0.9
- forge-47.4.10: Forge 1.20.1-47.4.10
- forge-14.23.5.2859: Forge 1.12.2-14.23.5.2859 (forge.cfg)
